description: Local Sales of Petroleum Products is a data set listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Oil and Environment. Bapco Refining supplies a wide range of high-quality petroleum products to meet the demand of the local market by covering a vast network of commercial and industrial customers and service stations. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Oil and Environment. Its tags are Oil & Gas, Petroleum. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
